_description: Machine-readable inventory of all managed units, existing modules, APIs, adapters, workers and dependency edges in the Ci+ system.

modules.description: Collects normalized status observations from adapters.

modules.name: ControlPlaneReconciler
modules.description: Desired/observed diff, drift classification, impact propagation.

modules.name: evaluatePolicy / buildApprovalRequest
modules.description: Approval and risk gates. All write/sensitive actions require policy evaluation.

modules.name: ControlPlaneAudit
modules.description: Immutable append-only action and verification history.

modules.name: ControlPlaneStatus

modules.name: ResponsibilityGraph

modules.name: CiKernel
modules.description: Signal normalization, classification, memory store integration.

modules.name: CiOrchestrator

modules.name: CompletionContract

modules.name: CheckpointStore

modules.name: PermissionGate

modules.name: ResultAggregator

verification_status_definitions.VERIFIED: Source declaration, dependent observation, and independent Ci+ verification all agree.
verification_status_definitions.DRIFT: Desired state does not match observed state.
verification_status_definitions.DEGRADED: Unit is reachable but reporting partial/reduced health.
verification_status_definitions.UNVERIFIED: No verification has been completed or last verification failed.
verification_status_definitions.CONFLICT: Contradictory claims exist and have not been resolved.
